sections.Profile:
"4 Star" is a dance-themed electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Manufacturing Company in July 1958. Designed by Harry Williams, the game features two flippers, four pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, six standup targets, and a gobble hole.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1958
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Good Times, Wood Rail, Dancing, Original Theme, Single level playfield
